note: Test set. Facts read from files; no model prediction or performance number computed.

checks.check: RECORDS lists the same recordings as SHA256SUMS.txt
every listed record has a verified EDF + scoring txt (SHA-256)
no record raised an error while being read
exactly one ECG channel per record
ECG channel label is 'ECG'
ECG sampling rate is 256 Hz in every record
ECG physical unit is a voltage (uV or mV)
EDF data-record count in header equals the count implied by file size
scoring txt columns
stage label vocabulary is Sleep stage W/N1/N2/N3/R
every stage annotation lasts 30 s (epoch length)
first stage epoch starts at the EDF start (onset 0)
stage epochs are contiguous (onset step exactly 30 s)
stage onsets lie on a 30 s grid from the EDF start
stage rows: Date/Time column equals EDF start + Recording onset (<= 1.5 ms)
lights rows: Date/Time column equals EDF start + Recording onset (<= 0.05 s)
checks.note: the onset column is printed with ~6 significant digits (e.g. 25618.7 for clock 07.06.28.740), so late lights annotations are rounded to 0.1 s; the clock column keeps ms

checks.check: scored epochs end inside the EDF
checks.note: epochs scored past the EDF end are dropped by load_hmc

checks.check: each record has at most one 'Lights off' and one 'Lights on'
lights off precedes lights on, both inside the EDF
no respiratory-event annotations in the scoring txt
checks.note: HMC scoring txt holds sleep stages and lights only; apnea is not evaluable on HMC

checks.check: no annotation types other than sleep stages and lights
demographics gender counts sum to the number of listed records
detected beat rate is physiological (0.5-2.5 beats/s = 30-150 bpm)
checks.note: a failure here is a property of the recording (lead-off/flat/clipped ECG), not of the loader; per docs/rr_rules.md such epochs get low coverage and are still evaluated

checks.check: every loaded epoch maps to W/R/S1/S2/S3
